user.title: WOOW ZHA Quirks
user.description:
This integration has no settings. Confirming will register the WOOW / Simon ZHA quirks, start the runtime hooks (knob rebind, relay resync, scene-switch activation, quirk self-heal) and create the combined climate entities for the supported AC panels.

Three of these change data that does not belong to this integration:

- **Orphan sweep** deletes stale ZHA entity registry entries.
- **Presence defaults** writes a curated configuration into WO_40117 presence sensors once per pairing.
- **Light effects** patches the ZHA light platform so the Gledopto dreamlight effects appear.

Removing the integration later does not undo the quirk registration or the light patch — that needs a Home Assistant restart.

confirm.title: WOOW ZHA Quirks must be set up again
confirm.description:
Version 1.4.0 removed setup through `configuration.yaml`. The `woow_zha_quirks:` key no longer does anything, so the runtime hooks and the climate entities for your AC panels are not running.

Submit to create the integration entry now. Afterwards, delete the `woow_zha_quirks:` line from `configuration.yaml`.

Your quirks themselves are unaffected and keep working either way.
